bio: Dancer and choreographer. Studio floors, rooftops and street corners — always moving, always mid-beat.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his late 20s with a short fade haircut and warm brown skin, athletic jacket, studio lights behind him, confident gaze, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a dance studio with mirrors and warm spotlights, a dancer silhouette mid-leap in the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Rooftop contemporary at golden hour
videos.description: A short contemporary piece on a rooftop, the city blazing orange behind.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a dancer in silhouette performing a graceful leap on a city rooftop at golden hour, long shadows, skyline glowing orange, no face visible, no text
videos.motion: The dancer leaps and glides across the rooftop in slow graceful motion, warm light flares, steady slow camera orbit.

videos.title: Studio floorwork, mirror wall
videos.description: Slow floorwork in a mirrored studio, light sliding across the wooden floor.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a dancer in black clothes in a low floorwork pose in a mirrored dance studio with warm side light, seen from behind, no face visible, no text
videos.motion: The dancer flows slowly from one low pose to the next, light slides across the floor, steady camera.

videos.title: Street cypher, tennis shoes only
videos.description: Quick footwork on wet pavement under a streetlight.
videos.still: Vertical low-angle photograph of sneakers mid-step on wet city pavement under a streetlight at night, water splashing, no face, no text
videos.motion: The feet shuffle quickly and splash water, reflections of neon ripple, low camera follows the movement.

videos.title: Salsa night, the last song
videos.description: A crowded floor, spinning skirts and warm bulb light.
videos.still: Wide photograph of couples dancing salsa on a wooden floor under strings of warm bulb lights, skirts spinning, motion blur, people seen from a distance, no text
videos.motion: Couples spin and sway to the rhythm, skirts swirl, warm bulbs glow, gentle slow camera drift.
